title: VEIL / 透幕

construction.topology: one connected watertight orientable shell; each through-hole adds one handle
construction.construction_method: shared 2D cell boundaries; analytic cylinder mapping; normal-offset shell and explicit rounded bore rings; no alpha texture or boolean
construction.sampling_note: Area is analytic smooth aperture footprint / developed mid-surface rectangle; not triangulated mesh area, projected visibility, porosity, or structural strength.

editorial_wide.purpose: Editorial wide view only; not a replacement for the square comparison camera.

normal_semantics: Analytic face-corner normals on explicit curved surface and real roundover; native storage/GLB corner vector tolerance is in the bound comparison report.
sampling_semantics: 64 vertices per aperture ring, 16 per shared cell edge; historical 32-point files and reports are not final production identities.
